question: Olympic bronze medallist boxer Vijender Singh hails from which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vijender Singh**, an Olympic bronze medallist boxer, hails from the state of **Haryana** in India.
 
• He is a professional boxer who made history by becoming the **first Indian boxer to win an Olympic medal** in boxing at the **2008 Beijing Olympics**.
 
• Vijender Singh was born in **Kaluwas village, Bhiwani district, Haryana**, which is known as the hub of boxing in India and has produced several successful boxers.
